# Folder Purpose: Handoff Violations

## Purpose

This folder stores generated Handoff consistency and policy issue reports.

The main generated report is:

```text
Open.md
```

## Generated By

```bat
tools\aiworkflow\handoff_supervisor.bat write-docs --execute
```

## Belongs Here

- Missing manifest field reports
- Invalid role or status reports
- Missing target-role request document reports
- Hidden approval-waiting issue reports
- Done-without-completion-notice reports

## Does Not Belong Here

- Code review findings
- QA test results
- Approval decisions
- Validation pass/fail verdicts
- DevLogs
- Runtime evidence

## Interpretation Rule

A violation report is a routing or metadata issue report.

It is not an implementation review verdict, validation result, approval record, or completion decision.
